text:
I'm going to post a short team message with the main lessons, keeping it to a few posts. The biggest loss was the nine discards, especially early ones of cards we didn't know yet, and signals ran out by turn 24 even though spending them on rank 1s early was reasonable.

I'm weighing the lesson that conserving signals matters: with none left and nothing playable, a rank-1 or rank-2 signal beats a discard. I'd also avoid discarding cards ranked above the next one needed, and when refilling signals, the discard should go to a known-dead or highest-rank card, since I lost a rank-4 of a three-card suit early that way.
